subject: [PATCH v2 09/17] selftests/mm: add order-parameterized khugepaged collapse cases

2026-08-07.patch_summary: This patch adds four new test cases to the selftests/mm/khugepaged context, which checks how large pages are collapsed by the khugepaged mechanism. The new cases check each aligned window individually and verify that only the populated window collapses in certain scenarios. Each case faults its region before MADV_HUGEPAGE with only the target order enabled, so the sources are always order 0 and the collapse product can only come from khugepaged. This patch aims to improve the testing of khugepaged's behavior by adding more specific and detailed test cases.
